question: Is selling to a cash buyer a good idea in Sebring, Florida?
answer: Selling to an off-market cash investor makes sense if you need an immediate 7-day closing, inherited an uninsurable property with severe structural damage, or want zero showings. However, wholesale cash investors typically offer 15% to 30% below true fair market value. By listing on the open MLS with Alyson Thomas, you attract competing retail cash buyers—especially incoming out-of-state retirees—who frequently pay full market value in cash without deep investor discounts.
